name: 7000-sharegpt-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: dense decoder (LlamaForCausalLM): 32 layers, 32 query heads and 8 KV heads (GQA 4:1), head_dim 128, hidden 4096, intermediate 14336, vocab 128256, context 8192, bfloat16, 8.03B params (~16.1 GB of weights). Ungated mirror of the base checkpoint; base model, not Instruct, so it carries no chat_template.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup 25%, no cooldown, bounded at 1000 requests with an 1800 s safety cap. streams=256 is this engine's own `max-num-seqs`, and the two must move together.
workload: `configs/data/sharegpt-1000-llama3.jsonl` -- 1000 real single-turn ShareGPT_V3 conversations, prompt lengths mean 215 / median 83 / p90 621 / max 997 and output lengths mean 198 / median 145 / p90 482 / max 863 (215196 prompt + 198343 output tokens over the file). `configs/data/make-dataset.py` regenerates it. Each request asks for exactly its row's output-token count, so EOS never truncates and the amount of generated work is fixed run to run. `request_format: plain` is REQUIRED: this checkpoint has no chat_template and a chat-formatted request fails outright.
purpose: An open-ended chat assistant on an 8-billion-parameter model, serving 256 concurrent plain-text conversations of a few hundred tokens on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM 0.5.4-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction.
# Do not add keys from a later vLLM. The engine is constructed in process -- no --host/--port.
#
# FLAT READER'S INPUT: `key: value` lines only, `-` converted to `_`, a value beginning `{` or `[`
# read as JSON. An indented YAML block silently never reaches the engine args.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B
tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 8192
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

# The admission cap on the running batch, and the same number as `scenario.json: streams`.
# Move the two together or not at all.
max-num-seqs: 256

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
swap-space: 16
use-v2-block-manager: true
enable-chunked-prefill: false
enable-prefix-caching: false
block-size: 16
seed: 0
disable-log-requests: true
